layers.definition: Exogenous computer-scenario assumptions and computer capability clock.
Technically plausible/accepted effects derived from CORE; includes quantitative and qualitative military mechanisms, not their historical adoption.
Changes plausibly realized by the opening of the US war after adoption, budget, production, training, and organizational clocks.
Materialized opening snapshot; principal rewind floor for normal wartime simulation.
Post-opening history as restartable checkpoint chain and deltas.
Calculations, long-form aircraft/ship studies, source digests, old branches, and evidence used to support other layers.

note: A legacy file may span multiple layers; primary_layer describes responsibility, secondary_layers signal required future splitting.
